bio.text: Phil Scott, a Republican, has been Governor of Vermont since January 2017 and advanced from the Republican primary for Governor on August 11, 2026.
He was previously Lieutenant Governor of Vermont from 2011 to 2017 and served five terms in the Vermont Senate representing Washington County.
He was a co-owner of a family construction business for more than thirty years and founded the Wheels for Warmth program in 2005.
He grew up in Barre, graduated from Spaulding High School and the University of Vermont, and lives in Berlin.
